| f-001 | defect | MAJOR | HIGH — post-plan chunk expansion bypasses the request token budget. runner::drain_embed calls batch::plan first; split_to_budget costs each ORIGINAL text and deliberately lets a single over-budget item ride alone. Only afterwards embed_items expands every item into overlapping chunks, accumulates every chunk in one texts vector, and makes one embedder.embed call. A request accepted at exactly TOKEN_BUDGET already grows from 200000 to 205400 estimated tokens; a larger single source grows without bound and can exceed the provider's aggregate request ceiling, fail every retry, and remain permanently unembedded. This violates the frozen seam that chunks are inputs to the same token-budget planner and recreates the original unsearchable-content defect one size class up. Smallest safe fix: sub-batch prepared chunks against the existing TOKEN_BUDGET, collect all returned vectors, and retain one final put_embeddings transaction so multi-chunk source atomicity survives; add a test proving multiple provider calls, each under budget, with every chunk present exactly once.
